import inspect
import click

option = click.Option(['--enabled/--disabled'])
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'--enabled'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=False) == "'--enabled'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--enabled' / '--disabled'"
option.opts = []
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'enabled'"
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--disabled'"
option.secondary_opts = []
assert option.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'enabled'"
assert inspect.signature(click.Parameter.get_error_hint).parameters['include_secondary'].kind == inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
print('Focused checks passed')

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/core.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/core.py'])
print('Original CRLF:', original.count(b'\r\n'), 'LF:', original.count(b'\n'))
old = b'    def get_error_hint(self, ctx: Context) -> str:'
new = b'    def get_error_hint(self, ctx: Context, *, include_secondary: bool = False) -> str:'
updated = original.replace(old, new, 1)
old = b'        hint_list = self.opts or [self.human_readable_name]'
new = b'        opts = self.opts + self.secondary_opts if include_secondary else self.opts\n        hint_list = opts or [self.human_readable_name]'
updated = updated.replace(old, new, 1)
assert p.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') == updated.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
p.write_bytes(updated)
'@ | python -B -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git status --short
